name: fetch-plus
description: web_fetch provider on Browserbase: Fetch, then Fetch with proxies, then a real browser session with captcha solving and a saved per-site login context; names the wall when every rung fails

browserbaseApiKey.label: Browserbase API key
browserbaseApiKey.help: SecretRef recommended, e.g. {"source":"store","provider":"default","id":"BROWSERBASE_API_KEY"}. Fallback: BROWSERBASE_API_KEY env var.

browserbaseProjectId.label: Browserbase project ID
browserbaseProjectId.help: Optional; Browserbase infers the project from the key. SecretRef or plain string. Fallback: BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID env var.

browserbaseApiKey.description: Browserbase API key: a SecretRef object or a string. Resolved by the core through the provider credentialPath; env BROWSERBASE_API_KEY is the fallback.

browserbaseProjectId.description: Browserbase project ID: a SecretRef object or a string. Optional. Env BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID is the fallback.

apiBaseUrl.description: Browserbase API base URL (override only for testing).

fetchFormat.description: raw = normal Fetch plus local Readability (cheapest, no project enablement needed); markdown = Browserbase Fetch Extract (priced higher, may need enablement; falls back to raw on a format error).

l2Proxies.description: Run L2. Off skips straight from L1 to L3.

skipL2ForJsShell.description: When L1 got a thin JavaScript shell, go straight to L3 (proxies cannot run JavaScript).

l3Proxies.description: Residential proxies on the L3 session; retried once without them on a proxy-provider refusal.

l3MaxSeconds.description: Hard cap for L3, session create to release.

l3SolveCaptchas.description: Browserbase captcha solving on the L3 session.

l3Verified.description: Browserbase Verified browser (advanced stealth). Scale plan only; leave off on Developer.

l3BlockAds.description: Ad blocking in the L3 browser.

l3RecordSession.description: Browserbase session recording (off keeps your pages out of replays).

l3NetworkIdleMs.description: Wait for network idle, at most this long.

l3CaptchaWaitMs.description: How long to wait out a captcha solve or a JS challenge page.

l3Driver.description: auto = playwright-core from the OpenClaw install, else the built-in minimal CDP client.

contextStrategy.description: One persistent Browserbase context per site group (site), per hostname (host), or none.

contextGroups.description: Extra site groups sharing one context, e.g. {"atlassian": ["atlassian.net", "atlassian.com"]}.

contextPersist.description: Save cookies and logins back into the context after each session.

contextWaitMs.description: Wait this long for a busy context before running without it.

contextSettleMs.description: Hold a context this long after a persisting session closes.

minVisibleChars.description: Below this much readable text, a page that should have more counts as blocked or thin.

totalMaxSeconds.description: Outer cap for one ladder run.

failureMode.description: auto: durable walls come back as a text result, transient walls (timeout, Browserbase busy or down) are thrown so the core does not cache them.

allowInsecureSsl.description: Let Browserbase Fetch skip TLS verification.

alertFetchCalls.description: Monthly Fetch API calls before an alerts.log line.

alertProxyBytes.description: Monthly proxy bytes before an alerts.log line.

alertBrowserHours.description: Monthly browser hours before an alerts.log line.

l3FirstHosts.description: Host suffixes that skip L1/L2 and start at L3 (real browser): sites whose JavaScript shell carries enough boilerplate to pass every text check, e.g. ["shop.example.com"].

minVisibleCharsHard.description: Hard floor: an HTML page with fewer article characters than this is thin whatever its size (a 139-character Akamai interstitial passes the soft check).
